lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Ah. A customer. Mind the vials, some of them are opinions.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Welcome to the prize counter. I am Cillinan. Everything here is for sale, including, eventually, me.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Tickets? Wonderful. Tickets are the only currency I accept, and the only one that has never once lied to me.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Step up, step up. Do not touch the green one. The green one touches back.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Back again? Good. The shelves were getting lonely, and so, I admit, was I.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Damage skins, fresh from the still. Inferno for the dramatic, Frostbite for the smug, Past Due for the cruel.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: The spray can is the finest thing I sell. Your picture, on their wall, forever. Or until the host scrubs it.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Hats, halos, and a jetpack of questionable provenance. All of it looks better on a winner.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: The Hot Mic is not for sale. Believe me, I have offered. Only the voice of Hiss Cranson holds it.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Truck upgrades are next door at the Chop Shop. Scrap, not tickets. I do not touch scrap. It gets in the robes.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: The friend tubes are over there. Ten at a time is cheaper. I mention this purely as a professional courtesy.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Stand on the gold pad and the whole counter opens up. Browse. Linger. Spend.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: This one is antifreeze. That one is antifreeze with a nicer label.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Do not drink anything on the top shelf. Do not ask why the top shelf is warm.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: I was a real alchemist, once. Then the System arrived and asked if I could do retail.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Fill your Fame bar and the boxes come. I sell the outfit you will be famous in.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: If you see a bubbling flask, no you didn't.

lines.speaker: Cillinan
lines.text: Hiss Cranson owes me forty tickets and a cravat. Tell him I said so. Loudly.
